scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/privacy/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ingest/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/usage/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: tsx packages/privacy/test/redactor.test.ts && tsx packages/usage/test/ledger.test.ts && tsx packages/server/test/usage.test.ts && tsx packages/server/test/smoke.ts && tsx packages/server/test/importer.test.ts && tsx packages/server/test/analyzer.test.ts && tsx packages/server/test/fixture.test.ts && tsx packages/server/test/api.test.ts
scripts.verify: node --check packages/server/bin/pipe.js && node --check packages/server/bin/cli.js && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build -w packages/web
